items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 初次见面，我是第五小队的现任副队长洛恩。如果有任何需要西风骑士团协助的事务，请直接前往骑士团求助。如果需要我个人帮忙，那我们还得好好商量一下。
items.text_en: Nice to meet you, I'm Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company. If you require assistance from the Knights of Favonius, please direct your request to headquarters. But if you need something from me, I'm all ears.

items.title: 闲聊·副队长
items.text: 想要成为队长，光有「队长级」的实力可不够。更重要的是…呵，我也不知道，不然我已经成队长了。
items.text_en: Being a captain takes more than just captain-grade strength. The most important thing is... Heh, I dunno. If I did, I'd be a captain by now.

items.title: 闲聊·风的归处
items.text: 呼…果然还是待在蒙德城最舒服，等一会再去喝点苹果酿好了…
items.text_en: Whew, Mondstadt really is the place to be. Can't wait to get my hands on some Apple Cider...

items.title: 闲聊·人际关系
items.text: 我在骑士团和大家的关系怎么样？嗯…至少，大家对我印象都挺深的，这样也还不错。
items.text_en: How do I get along with the other Knights? Hmm... Well, I'm certain I've left a deep impression. That can only be a good thing, right?

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 雨势不小啊，不知道又有多少东西被它冲刷殆尽了。
items.text_en: Huh, the rain's getting heavy. Who knows what the floods will wash away?

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 雨过天晴，权当之前那场雨从未发生。
items.text_en: The sky's clearing up. It's like those showers never even happened.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 雷声可以盖过许多东西，但绝对盖不住你自己的心跳。
items.text_en: Thunder drowns out many things, but never the beat of your own heart.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 我十分热爱猫尾酒馆…尤其是在这种天气下。
items.text_en: There's no place like The Cat's Tail... especially in weather like this.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 起风了，可惜我手头没有蒲公英，不然撕点纸吧，感觉也差不多。
items.text_en: Whew, wind's picking up... Too bad there aren't any dandelions around. Guess we'll just have to tear up some paper instead, huh?

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 我非常怀念果酒湖。
items.text_en: It's times like these when I really miss Cider Lake.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早上好。今天要忙什么？
items.text_en: Good morning. What's the plan today?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午饭吃过了？行啊，下午还有事要做呢。
items.text_en: Already stopped for lunch? Great, we've got work to do this afternoon.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 今天晚上…嗯，给队员们来一趟「袭营训练」吧。
items.text_en: Tonight... Mhm. Let's treat the troops to a surprise attack drill.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 晚安，记得早点休息。无论你怎么熬夜，明天都会到来的。
items.text_en: Good night. Better get some rest, 'cause tomorrow's coming, whether you like it or not.

items.title: 关于洛恩自己·痛觉留存
items.text: 在平时治疗时，我尽量不使用麻醉类药物，一是这种东西会影响战斗，二是…呵，从某种角度来说，我还挺愿意在战斗之后仔细感受「痛觉」的，毕竟这证明我活了下来，而我的敌人，则什么都感受不到了。
items.text_en: I try to avoid anesthetics — they make it hard to fight. Besides... heh, I kinda like to savor the pain. It reminds me that I'm alive, unlike my enemies, who feel nothing at all.

items.title: 关于洛恩自己·力量与借口
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「骑士之铭」剧情对于某些人来说，「力量」是一个很好用的借口，只要用上了它，任何失败和挫折都能找到原因，任何不安和恐惧都能寻见源头…或许，有一个明确的目标，确实能够给人们一种怪异的安全感吧。就算…这种「安全感」的背后，隐藏着更为恐怖和巨大的影子。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A Knight's Legacy"For some, power is a convenient excuse. It gives them a reason for failure, a justification for fear... Perhaps having a goal really does provide people with some strange sense of safety. Even if hidden behind their safety is a far more terrifying shadow.

items.title: 关于我们·战斗方式
items.text: 我的战斗方式？哈哈哈哈哈，找到领头的，和他好好打一场，尽可能快地分出胜负，就这么简单。我的队友们应该都已经习惯了。当然了，不习惯也没用。
items.text_en: My fighting style? Hahahaha, couldn't be more simple! Seek out the leader, engage them in combat, and decide the victor as quickly as possible. The other knights should be used to it by now, but if they're not, what difference does it make?

items.title: 关于我们·职责所在
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启完成「骑士之铭」剧情如你所见，我已经是副队长了，希奥多那个傻瓜也正在承受他该受的惩罚。不过在我看来，他的才能还能派上一些用场，等他赎完了罪，我还想把他捞回第五小队呢，但副官是做不了了，他就做个普通队员吧。不过，想要彻底相信他——还有我——都为时尚早。你相信我，也有那个相信我的「实力」？哈哈哈哈哈，不愧是「荣誉骑士」，和传闻中一样可靠。不然你直接来做我们「第五小队」的队长吧，法尔伽肯定会答应的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "A Knight's Legacy"As you can see, I'm vice captain, while that fool Theodore got exactly what he deserved. Still, I feel like his talents can be put to good use. Once he's atoned for his sins, I plan to drag him back to the 5th Company. Not as an officer, obviously, but he can serve in the rank and file. Although it's too early to trust him completely — or me, for that matter.You trust me? And you have the strength to back it up? Hahahaha! Just what I'd expect from the Honorary Knight... As reliable as the rumors suggest. You'd make a good captain of the 5th Company, I'm sure Varka wouldn't object!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启在执行任务的时候，这枚「神之眼」的确派上了不少用场。可惜，它只能用来剿灭有形的魔兽，不能抚平无形的创害。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4This Vision has proved pretty useful out in the field. Just a shame it's only good for killing monsters I can touch — not the unseen ones that linger within.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 我不喝酒，酒对我来说唯一的作用就是给伤口消毒。特别是晨曦酒庄的陈年蒲公英酒，消毒的效果和痛觉都很明显，而且在消毒的同时，我还能顺便欣赏一下我的同僚们——特别是法尔伽——抽搐的眼角，哈哈哈哈——
items.text_en: Ah, I don't drink. The only use I have for alcohol is disinfecting my wounds. In that regard, Dawn Winery's older Dandelion Wine is the most potent — both in terms of its disinfectant properties and the sweet stinging pain it delivers. Plus, when I use it on the others, I get to see them squirm — Varka's the most fun to watch. Hehehe!

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 我之前一直对蒲公英过敏，听砂糖说有一种「脱敏疗法」之后，我就买了许多蒲公英放在屋里，每隔一段时间就去主动吸入一点，以此来治疗我的过敏症状。结果怎么样？反正我现在遇见蒲公英已经不打喷嚏了。但我不得不说，打喷嚏打到头晕目眩的感觉，还是不可多得的。
items.text_en: I used to be allergic to Dandelions, but then Sucrose told me about "desensitization therapy." I filled my room with Dandelions and made sure to breathe deeply from time to time. Did it work? Put it this way, I don't sneeze around Dandelions anymore. But I must admit, I kind of miss the feeling of sneezing till I'm dizzy...

items.title: 关于法尔伽·药物耐受
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「骑士之铭」剧情法尔伽对于药物的抗性越来越高了，前几天我调配的药物居然只是让他红了红脸，要不是他瞪了我一眼，我都要怀疑自己究竟下没下药了。唉，要是还在挪德卡莱的话，我都想要给他掺点那种带月矩力的植物了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A Knight's Legacy"Varka's resistance to medicine keeps growing by the day. I mixed him a draught a few days ago that barely flushed his cheeks. If he hadn't glared at me afterwards, I'd have doubted whether I put the medicine in at all. *sigh*... If only we were still in Nod-Krai, I could drop in a few of those kuuvahki plants...

items.title: 关于法尔伽·团长职责
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启团长的职责？就法尔伽而言，基本上是带人出去打架吧。剩下的都被他甩给琴团长了，哈哈哈，毕竟敌人真的会被消灭，但文书工作真的没有终结啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Grand Master's duties? When it comes to Varka, it's mostly leading people into battle. The rest gets dumped on Jean, haha. Enemies, well, you can kill them for good, but paperwork... Paperwork never truly dies.

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「致予远征之人」剧情正是因为有这位勤勉的代理团长坐镇蒙德城，「大团长」才能在挪德卡莱放手施为，现在他回到了蒙德城…好吧，他也会继续放手施为，情况好像没有什么改变。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition"It's only because the Acting Grand Master was holding down the fort in Mondstadt that the "actual" Grand Master was able to swan off to Nod-Krai. Now that he's back... well, he'll likely continue to do as he pleases. I don't think much will change.

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启凯亚很擅长模仿其他骑士小队队长的签名，特别是琴团长的签名，他伪造得堪称天衣无缝，几乎没有破绽。他练习这个的目的？凯亚说，这是为了自己给自己批假，我相信他，毕竟以他的品格，应该也做不出来更过分的事了…呵呵。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kaeya has a real knack for imitating the other Captains' signatures, not to mention Jean's. In fact, his forgeries are so good, it's practically impossible to spot the difference. Kaeya says he only does it to sign off on his own applications for leave. Personally, I think he's telling the truth — too much moral fiber in that one, haha.

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启听安柏说，她和琴团长商量好了，过段时间会有些不叫「侦察骑士」的侦察员来给她帮忙，可喜可贺啊，她总算不用一个人在蒙德城上空来回飞了。不过这么一想，飞行执照考试的条例和考纲是不是也很陈旧了，不然，也一起更新了吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Amber said she's already talked things over with Acting Grand Master Jean. She asked for some recon officers to come help her out, though they won't be official outriders. Regardless, it's certainly cause to celebrate. Now, she won't have to fly back and forth over Mondstadt all by herself. Although come to think of it, the gliding license exam itself seems a bit outdated... Maybe it's time that got an update, too?

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「骑士之铭」剧情迪卢克老爷，还是应该说迪卢克「前辈」。从某个角度上来说，我们俩都被同一个混账坑害得不轻，现在新仇旧恨都已经清算完毕，他还不考虑回西风骑士团？就算不能做最年轻的队长了，也能做资历最老的队员啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A Knight's Legacy"Diluc... When you think about it, we both fell victim to the same scoundrel, but now that those scores have been settled, is he really never coming back to the Knights of Favonius? He can't go back to being the youngest captain, but he could sure have a go at being the oldest knight.

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启诺艾尔还没有成为正式骑士啊，都过了这么长时间，我还以为她肯定通过骑士试炼了呢…不知道法尔伽在想什么，难道要给诺艾尔准备一个超级大试炼？那她的骑士称号到底要多厉害，才能配得上她的训练时长啊…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Noelle's still not officially a knight, huh. How long's it been now? I thought for sure she'd have passed the selection trials... Is Varka holding out for some kind of special trial just for her? Her knightly title's gonna have to be pretty long to match the length of her training...

items.title: 关于优菈
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我对优菈最深的印象，就是她那双靴子踢踏地板的声音，只要她脚步急一点，我隔着一层楼都能听见咚咚咚的声音，既响亮又有穿透力，就和优菈的剑术一样，印象深得根本忘不掉。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4What stands out most about Eula is the sound of her boots stomping about the place. When she's in a rush, you can hear the "thump-thump-thump" from a floor away. Just like her fighting style — loud and penetrating, an impression so deep it's impossible to forget.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启第五小队所用的军备消耗品是第八小队和阿贝多一块开发的，弩箭、弹药和各类炼金产品的质量都很不错，我偶尔也会去拜访他的办公室，顺便委托他做些新的武器研究。不过，最近和我对接的人换成了砂糖，阿贝多应该是又去忙其他研究了吧…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The 5th Company's consumables are all developed by Albedo and the 8th Company. Our crossbow bolts, bullets, and various alchemical products are all top quality. I sometimes drop by Albedo's office with plans for new weapons research. Though recently, it's been Sucrose receiving my requests instead. Guess Albedo must be working on something big, again...

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启法尔伽之前和我说，他觉得那位愚人众执行官「队长」用蜡笔都能戳爆遗迹守卫，所以呢，我用好吃的和可莉换了一盒子蜡笔，准备带给法尔伽，到时候如果遇见了魔物，正好让他亲手试一试。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Varka told me he thinks that Fatui Harbinger, The Captain, could have taken out a Ruin Guard with just a crayon. So, I traded some snacks with Klee for a box of them, and I'm gonna bring them to Varka. Next time he runs into a monster, we'll see how formidable a weapon it really is.

items.title: 关于米卡
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启米卡很擅长测绘，而我很擅长测谎。之前，他给我的测绘图上专门掩盖了魔物聚集点，就怕我一个人冲过去。而我只是看了看他的表情，就知道这张图上哪里的魔物最多。可惜啊米卡，沉默也没用。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mika might be a skilled cartographer, but I'm even more skilled when it comes to sniffing out a lie. He once gave me a map where he deliberately left out all the monster gathering points, 'cause he was scared I'd charge in alone. But, y'know, one look at his face, and I knew exactly where the monsters were. Can't believe he thought silence would be enough to foil me.

items.title: 想要了解洛恩·其一
items.text: 抱歉啊，我没有什么阴暗深沉的「有趣秘密」。
items.text_en: Sorry to disappoint, but I don't have any deep, dark secrets worth sharing with anyone else.

items.title: 想要了解洛恩·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启虽然平时用长枪比较多，但我好歹也是第五小队的人，弩箭和铳枪的练习也是没落下的。至于准度…反正我打蓬蓬果和史莱姆挺准的，基本算是抬手就能中的程度吧。我听说稻妻有一种叫做飘浮灵的东西很难打？有意思，下次拿它试试手吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I prefer to use a polearm, but I still belong to the 5th Company, so I make sure to keep up with my crossbow and musket practice. As for accuracy... Well, I'm pretty good at hitting Bloatty Floatties and Slimes. I don't even really need to aim. I heard there's something called a Specter in Inazuma that's really hard to hit? Maybe I can test my aim on one of those next time.

items.title: 想要了解洛恩·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情第五小队？只是一支普通的远程支援队伍而已，没什么值得说的。虽说我们的火力还算过得去，但要是对上某些…过于特殊的敌人，我们最多就只能在旁边做做掩护了。就像是跟随法尔伽阻击猎月人那次一样，到最后，主攻完全变成了大团长，我们都被命令散去周围阻击狂猎…只有这样，我们才不会被卷入他和猎月人的战斗里。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"The 5th Company? Just an ordinary ranged support team, nothing worth mentioning. We can lay down some decent firepower, but if we're faced with... truly exceptional enemies, the most we can do is provide cover from the sidelines. Like that time we followed Varka to intercept the Rächer of Solnari... In the end, the main assault was left entirely to the Grand Master, while we were ordered to form a perimeter and hold off the Wild Hunt. That was the only way we wouldn't get swept up in his battle with Rerir.

items.title: 想要了解洛恩·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启为什么我坚持用长枪？那是因为…战场上最好的诱饵，当然是看起来像是队伍主官的人啊，有我吸引住敌人，其他队员只要尽情开火就好。至于危险的敌人…哈哈哈，越是紧张，我越是能集中精神，那种极致的专注感非常美妙…可惜啊，离开挪德卡莱之后，能让我放手一战的地方太少了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Why do I insist on using a polearm? I'll put it this way... the tastiest bait on the battlefield is the one who looks the most like a commander. I can draw the enemy's attention while giving everyone else the space to fire at will. As for dangerous enemies... Hahaha, the more intense it gets, the easier I find it to concentrate. That feeling of pure focus really is to die for... Just a pity that, ever since I left Nod-Krai, there have been too few battles where I can truly lose myself in the moment.

items.title: 想要了解洛恩·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启和敌人展开贴身战的时候害不害怕？怎么说呢，我觉得敌人那边应该「更」害怕吧。我出枪的速度是不会慢的。再说了，我背后还有医疗骑士等着呢…敌人也有怎么办？嗯，那我就只能尽可能抢先干掉对面的医疗人员了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Do I feel fear when fighting at close quarters? Hah! Not as much as my enemy does. I'm no slouch, you know. Besides, I've got medics waiting in the rear... What if the enemy has them too? Hmm, then I'll just have to take out their medics first.

items.title: 洛恩的爱好
items.text: 除了上战场厮杀，我平时的最大爱好，就是给我亲爱队友们的平淡生活，添上几分「惊喜」，这也算是日常训练的一环，骑士可得时时刻刻提高警惕啊。
items.text_en: Besides the rush of battlefield slaughter, my favorite pastime is preparing little "surprises" to brighten the lives of my dearest brothers and sisters in arms. I consider it part of their training — knights need to stay vigilant at all times, after all.

items.title: 洛恩的烦恼
items.text: 驻扎荆夫港的好日子结束了，回到蒙德城，琴团长可没有大团长那么好说话了，唉，就不能再给我派一点外勤任务吗？
items.text_en: The good days of being stationed at Dornman Port are over. Now I'm back in Mondstadt, and Acting Grand Master Jean is nowhere near as easygoing as Grand Master Varka. *sigh*... Aren't there any more missions in the field they could send me on?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我比较喜欢吃辣一点的东西。平时在外面执勤的时候，也喜欢嚼点晒干的绝云椒提神…「那叫绝云椒椒」？谢谢，我只说一个「椒」字就好。
items.text_en: I like to eat spicy food. When I'm out on patrol, I often chew on dried Jueyun Peppers to keep myself alert... They're called "Jueyun Chilis"? Thanks for the heads up, but I think I'll stick to calling them peppers...

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 别喝酒，好吗？在挪德卡莱驻扎的时候，我总是被那些喝多了的骑士们吵醒…这帮人喝到最后，已经不知道自己在喝什么了，就算我把酒换成了…呃，算了，没什么。
items.text_en: Don't drink, alright? When I was stationed in Nod-Krai, I was always woken up by drunken knights... By the end of the night, those guys couldn't even tell what they were drinking anymore, not even when I swapped their booze for... uhm, never mind, forget I said that.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 谢谢，很合我口味。这道菜好吃到…我都有点怀疑，你是不是偷偷调查过我了。没事的，我也调查过你，我们两清了。
items.text_en: Whew! Thank you, this is exactly what I like. In fact, it suits me so well... I suspect you've been secretly investigating my preferences! But I'm not mad — after all, I have my own file on you...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 我之前学习如何在饭菜里下毒的时候，基本上也是做到不会让任何人起疑的程度…你已经下毒了？噢，我对毒药的耐性很高，让我再吃点。
items.text_en: Back when I was learning how to poison meals, I got so good that no one suspected a thing... You've poisoned this already? Not to worry, I have a high tolerance for poison. In fact, I think I'll have some more.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: …这么直白的陷阱，我就…不主动往里面跳了。下次还是换我来做菜吧。
items.text_en: ...Well, this is clearly a trap, and one I think I'd best avoid. Next time, how about you let me do the cooking?

items.title: 生日
items.text: 今天是你生日，拿着这把微型手弩吧，是我自己琢磨出来的，应该刚好能戴在你的手腕上…我什么时候量的尺寸？目测的，我可是第五小队副队长，相信我的目测能力。哦对了，这把手弩还能反向发射，以防有人背后偷袭嘛，只要摁这里…哈哈哈，别躲嘛，这柄手弩的安全锁还扣着呢，难道我看起来，像是那种送朋友手弩，然后看着他摁动发射扳机，把弩箭戳到自己身上的人吗？
items.text_en: Today's your birthday, so I got you a mini-crossbow. I came up with the design myself. It should be the perfect size for your wrist... When did I measure your wrist? Don't worry, I did it by eye. You can trust my ability to gauge things like this — I'm vice captain of the 5th Company, after all. Oh, right, this crossbow can also fire backward, just in case someone sneaks up on you. You just press... here. Hahaha, no need to duck! The safety lock is still on. Do I look like the kind of person who gives a friend a crossbow just to watch them shoot themselves...

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启感觉不错，武器都使得更顺手了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1I feel great. Even my weapon feels easier to handle.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启好像能看得更远了…下次出枪的时候，应该能更准一些了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2I feel like I can see even further now... This should help improve my aim.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启头脑更清醒了，哈，突然想到了一个训练的新方法。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4It's like my mind's gotten so much clearer. Hah, I just thought of a new way to train.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启看来，以我现在的实力，应该足够做个「副队长」了？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Guess I'm strong enough to be a "proper" vice captain now, huh?

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 开战了！
items.text_en: Let's fight!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 发抖吧。
items.text_en: Tremble, I won't judge.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 一个不留！
items.text_en: Leave none standing!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 出奇制胜。
items.text_en: Betcha weren't ready for this!

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 时机正好。
items.text_en: Now's our chance!

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 哼。
items.text_en: Hmph!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 吵吵嚷嚷…待宰羔羊。
items.text_en: Like lambs to the slaughter.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 挣扎——也没用！
items.text_en: Struggle all you want!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 哈哈哈，你不会安息的。
items.text_en: No fairytale ending for you!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 收获颇丰啊，来吧，看看里面装了什么。
items.text_en: Ah, the spoils of war. Let's see what's inside.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 好像不太值钱啊…不过，反正是白捡的，拿上吧。
items.text_en: A meager haul... Still, it'd be rude not to take it.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 嗯，没有陷阱，也没有剧毒烟雾…没劲。
items.text_en: Huh, no traps, no poison smoke... How unimaginative.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 感觉不错…继续！
items.text_en: Hah... Keep it coming!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: …还没完呢！
items.text_en: ...This isn't over yet!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 正好当我的对手！
items.text_en: ...Now that's my kind of opponent!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 实力不足，就退后！
items.text_en: If you can't keep up, fall back!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 让我尝尝！
items.text_en: My turn!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 我的…局限…
items.text_en: So this... is my limit...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 不…尽兴…
items.text_en: I still haven't had... enough...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 风啊…告诉…我…
items.text_en: Wind... tell me why...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 小伎俩。
items.text_en: Cheap trick.

items.title: 普通受击·其二
items.text: 一点感觉也没有。
items.text_en: Didn't even feel it.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 实力不错啊…
items.text_en: Got some fight in you, after all...

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text_en: Heh...!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 走吧，活动活动。
items.text_en: Time for some action.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 打头阵？行。
items.text_en: Scout ahead? I'm on it.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 这次我来殿后。
items.text_en: I'll guard our retreat.
